questions.question: How did Nuñez end up in the country of the blind?
options: He was collecting herbs and got lost.
He was invited by Yacob to teach the villagers.
He was sent there by the government.
While climbing one of Ecuador's highest mountains, he lost his footing, fell over a cliff, and found himself in a place cut off from the world.
questions.answer: While climbing one of Ecuador's highest mountains, he lost his footing, fell over a cliff, and found himself in a place cut off from the world.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.130 第1段：Nuñez, an experienced mountaineer, was climbing up one of Ecuador's highest mountains when he lost his footing … fell over a cliff edge … found himself in a place cut off from the world. p.135 也考 (A) collecting herbs 為錯誤。

questions.question: Why did all the roads in the village have low walls alongside them?
options: The paths were specially built to help the blind villagers navigate safely.
To mark the border of the village.
To protect the crops from the wind.
questions.answer: The paths were specially built to help the blind villagers navigate safely.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.131 第3段：The paths, lined with low walls, had been specially built to help them navigate safely.

questions.question: When Nuñez first realized everyone was blind, he thought, "In the country of the blind, the one-eyed man is king." What does this show?
options: He felt superior to the sightless villagers.
He was afraid of the villagers.
He wanted to become blind too.
questions.answer: He felt superior to the sightless villagers.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.131 第2段：Feeling superior to these sightless people…。p.133 Reading Comprehension：Nuñez 一開始是 arrogant（傲慢的），因為 he felt superior to the blind villagers 且 believed his gift of sight should make him a "king"。

questions.question: Which statement is TRUE according to the story?
options: Nuñez sacrificed his eyes to cure Medina.
Nuñez came across the village when collecting herbs.
Nuñez was stunned by the villagers' great knowledge and the way they lived.
Nuñez won the respect of the villagers with his ability to see.
questions.answer: Nuñez was stunned by the villagers' great knowledge and the way they lived.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.135 Comprehension 3：他對村民的知識感到驚訝（he was amazed at their great knowledge）；村民反而可憐他，他最後逃走，並沒有犧牲眼睛。

questions.question: 【多選題】Why didn't the villagers admire Medina's beauty? (應選 2 項)
options: (A) She had well-defined features that lacked the smoothness the villagers valued.
(B) Her weak voice was neither powerful nor pleasing enough to meet their standards.
(C) She could see while the others could not.
(D) She was an outsider from another country.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.132：No one else admired Medina's beauty, as she had well-defined features that lacked the smoothness the villagers valued. Furthermore, her weak voice was neither powerful nor pleasing enough to meet their standards.

questions.question: Under what condition would Medina marry Nuñez?
options: He had to have his eyes removed so he could truly become one of them.
He had to become the king of the village.
He had to leave the village with her.
He had to teach everyone to see.
questions.answer: He had to have his eyes removed so he could truly become one of them.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.132：村民把他的「視力」看成必須被「治癒」的危險妄想，Medina 也同意，說服他摘除鼻子兩側的奇怪球體（眼睛）；in return for Nuñez's great sacrifice, she agreed to marry him。

questions.question: What made Nuñez finally decide to flee?
options: On the morning of his surgery, he saw the splendor of the sunrise and realized he was making a huge mistake.
questions.answer: On the morning of his surgery, he saw the splendor of the sunrise and realized he was making a huge mistake.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.133：it wasn't until the day of his surgery that he realized he was making a huge mistake. That morning, he once again beheld the splendor of the sunrise…Driven by the desire to save his sight, he fled the country of the blind.

questions.question: What does Nuñez struggle to accept about himself in the village?
options: God will help those who help themselves.
Sight does not make him better than others.
questions.answer: Sight does not make him better than others.

questions.question: 【多選題】According to "How the Country of the Blind Came to Be," which are correct? (應選 3 項)
options: (A) The villagers still remembered clearly what sight meant.
(B) The original settlers could see, but a strange disease caused their children to be born blind.
(C) After about fifteen generations (about 300 years), no one in the community could see.
(D) The villagers developed other senses and built their village to suit their needs.
(E) A doctor from outside visited the village often.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.130 附欄：失明經過許多世代形成；最初移民看得見，怪病使孩子天生失明；約十五代（約 300 年）後無人能看見；與外界隔絕、無法求醫；村民發展出其他感官、建造適合自己的家園，甚至不再有「視力」的概念。

questions.question: 【多選題】Which are common types of writing hooks? (應選 3 項)
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.128 Reading Strategy：寫作鉤子用在開頭段落吸引讀者，常見有問題、軼事（anecdote）、事件描述、定義、統計數字、引言、誤解（misconception）；鉤子不一定直接說出主旨，但之後要與主旨連結。

questions.question: The War of the Worlds passage begins with a newspaper line, "Thousands of persons called the police…against the raids." What type of hook is it, and what does it create?
options: A question; it gives the answer at once.
A quote; it creates a sense of urgency and mystery.
A definition; it gives a step-by-step guide.
Statistics; it explains the main idea in detail.
questions.answer: A quote; it creates a sense of urgency and mystery.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.128～129：引用 1938 年 10 月 31 日的報紙內容是「引言」(a quote) 型鉤子，營造緊迫與神秘感。文中也指出當年的恐慌其實被誇大（overstated），是媒體影響大眾觀念的早期例子。

questions.question: Which graphic organizer best helps you understand the structure of the story, and what is its order?
options: Mind Map: one main idea in the center
Freytag's Pyramid: exposition → inciting incident → rising action → climax → falling action → resolution
questions.answer: Freytag's Pyramid: exposition → inciting incident → rising action → climax → falling action → resolution
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.134：故事結構最適合用 Freytag's Pyramid（鋪陳、觸發事件、情節上升、高潮、情節下降、結局）；依課文順序：失足 → 來到盲人村 → 解釋視力失敗 → 戀愛遭反對 → 被要求犧牲眼睛 → 改變心意逃走。

questions.question: Which sentence correctly summarizes "Sam: Did you get the test results yesterday? John: No. I got them this morning."?
options: Not until this morning John got the results.
It was not until this morning that John got the results of the test.
It was until this morning that John didn't get the results.
It was not until this morning when John got the results.
questions.answer: It was not until this morning that John got the results of the test.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.146 Practice B 範例：It was not until this morning that John got the results of the test。強調句要用 that（不是 when）；若把 Not until 放句首，主要子句要倒裝（did John get）。
